title: Cells Grouping Detection and Confusing Labels Correction on Cervical Pathology Images
summary: PGCC-Net grouped and detected cervical pathology cells and addressed confusing labels using cytology images. It reports image-level model evaluation, not screening outcomes or clinical benefit. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
